Andhra Pradesh AI Tax System Praised by GST Officials

The Goods and Services Tax (GST) Council has praised Andhra Pradesh's artificial intelligence-driven tax administration system. Officials highlighted the state's use of AI in tax administration. The system has been recognized for its effectiveness in managing tax processes. This recognition came during a meeting of GST officials.
